# TradeIQ CSE

TradeIQ CSE is a learning workspace for exploring delayed Colombo Stock Exchange data, testing rules on historical prices, and practising trades with virtual money.

- [Browse CSE securities](/markets)
- [How TradeIQ works](/how-it-works)
- [Sign in](/login)

Market information is end-of-day and may be delayed. Paper trades do not reach an exchange. Backtests are historical simulations, not forecasts or investment advice.
